createCard.title: New OAuth Client
createCard.description: Create a new client to integrate external applications with PCReady securely.

infoAlert.title: What is an OAuth Client?
infoAlert.description: An OAuth client allows an external application (e.g. an automation tool, a mobile app or an ERP system) to securely access PCReady data without sharing user passwords. Create a client only if you are connecting an external application that needs to operate on behalf of users who authorize it.

flowAlert.title: Supported Flow
flowAlert.description: PCReady exposes the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow (response_type=code). Integrators start access by redirecting the user to the authorization endpoint, then exchange the code for a token. Client Credentials flow is not supported for these clients.

form.nameHelp: Name visible to those authorizing the app and in admin lists.
form.descriptionHelp: Free text to remember who this integration is intended for.
form.redirectHelp: The URL where PCReady redirects the browser after the user has logged in and granted permissions (OAuth 2.0 redirect URI). Must match exactly what is configured in the external app: you can find the value in that app's documentation or developer settings. One URL per line.
form.scopeHelp: Select what the application can request from users during authorization. Each entry shows the technical permission name in parentheses.

created.title: Client created
created.description: {{name}}: use these values in your application. The secret will not be shown again.
created.saveAlertDescription: The Client Secret is shown once only and will not be recoverable from PCReady after closing this window. Copy it and store it in a secret manager or secure configuration before proceeding.
created.howToUse: How to use this client (Authorization Code)
created.step1Text: 1. Redirect the user (already authenticated on PCReady) to authorization with query parameters.
created.postBodyText: Typical body: grant_type=authorization_code, code, client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri (as above).

rotated.title: New Client Secret
rotated.description: The previous secret is no longer valid. Update the integrations using this client immediately.
rotated.alertDescription: This value will not be shown again after closing the window.

confirmRotate.title: Rotate Client Secret?
confirmRotate.description: Rotating the secret for "{{name}}" will immediately stop the current value from working. All integrations using the old secret will fail until you update the configuration. This action is recorded in audit.

confirmDisable.title: Disable this client?
confirmDisable.description: Client "{{name}}" will not be able to start new OAuth flows until you reactivate it. Existing consents remain in archive.

confirmRevoke.title: Permanently revoke this client?
confirmRevoke.description: Revoking "{{name}}" is irreversible: you cannot reactivate this client. Create a new client if you need a similar integration.
